steps: If one were to name the most renowned health practice of the Loong, it would, of course, be the art of massage.
Ignoring your doctor's orders? That makes you a very naughty child.
I explain Coronis's theory to the Guard. They finally agree to release her, provided she remains under strict surveillance.
When we check on the patient, we discover he drank an entire month's supply of herbal tea in a single sitting.
Your tea tasted so good I couldn't help myself...==W== It worked fast too, so I figured the more I drank, the better.
But after I finished drinking it, I couldn't get to sleep. Then, when I finally did drift off, I was out like a light until just now.
Seriously...==W== This shouldn't become such a big deal.==W== Please be more careful next time!
It looks like everyone else followed their prescriptions. He is the only outlier.
Thank goodness Coronis intervened in time.
Even beneficial substances become poison in excess. In the future, you must follow the prescription instructions.
You were lucky this time. If it happens again...==W== You may not even wake up from your nap.
I am terribly sorry for the trouble.==W== As an apology, my colleagues at the Loong Guard insisted I treat you both to hotpot. Please, eat up!
Hehe...==W== Well, I certainly won't say no.
Eat up, my dear assistant. You deserve the credit for solving this puzzle.
You did well too. This was so sudden...==W== I'm glad we managed to resolve it.
Patients always complain that my medicine is too bitter. I thought improving the palatability would help, but it seems I overcorrected...==W== Hehe.
As they say, "good medicine tastes bitter." Perhaps...==W== I should make the flavor even more unbearable next time?
But if it is too bitter, people will be afraid to drink it...==W== Striking that balance is tough.
Well, what can you do? Every patient comes with their own unique set of demands.
Hm? But you actually sound like you are enjoying yourself.
Naturally.==W== If not for this incident, I never would have gathered so much data on these fascinating new symptoms.
Sigh...==W== Coronis always claims she treats people solely for the sake of "research"...
But deep down, I know there is more to it than that.
Hm? Why are you staring at me like that?
You have sauce on the corner of your mouth again.
She...==W== She touched my lips again!
Phew...==W== Back at last. And here I thought this would be a peaceful, relaxing vacation.
Then tomorrow, we absolutely have to visit that resort! Especially since our original plans fell apart...
So, if I understand correctly...==W== You want me to take a full day to just relax. Is that right?
And you did say ...==W== you wanted me to get some proper rest. Correct?
I did say that...==W== I-Is something wrong?
I would prefer to start relaxing right now instead of tomorrow.
How about you give me a massage, dear assistant?
Precisely. That interrogation actually had me quite on edge. I was holding myself so stiffly...==W== Now I am sore all over, and I urgently need someone to help work out those knots!
There are plenty of physicians in Cangwu who are way better at massage than I am. Why not...
Don't bother. You will do just fine.
But...==W== I'm not trained.==W== What if I use too much force or mess something up?
You are the assistant I personally selected.==W== I trust you. Unless...==W== All that talk about supporting me was just empty words?
N-No, of course not! Fine...==W== But don't blame me if I'm terrible at this!
Mmm...==W== Ah...==W== Right there,==W== Hehe...==W== Your hands==W== are so skilled...==W== Hm?!
I'm sorry, I'm sorry! Did I hurt you?
No,==W== no need to apologize...==W== If anything,==W== could you use a little more pressure?
Stimulating the acupoints like this,==W== my whole body will warm up in no time.
Mmm...==W== Yes, that feels so good… Ah!
Hey,==W== don't just stick to the soles;==W== calves and thighs, too…
This is my request;==W== you needn't have any reservations.==W== What's wrong?==W== Your hands have stopped.
Ah~==W== Could it be ...==W== Heh.==W== While you're touching my feet,==W== you start thinking about something else?
I understand, though.==W== I've experienced it too.==W== After all...==W== Feeling a sense of excitement==W== when touching another's body is perfectly natural♪
What I want to do ...==W== all rests on my whim.
… Every inch of the other person is under my complete control...==W== When casting spells, I even experience this illusion.
That's what you meant by "something else"?!
Mmm~ So, what exactly were you thinking just now?==W== Don't be shy, be a good ==SEX9== and tell me…
Give me a break... Stop teasing me.
Hehe,==W== you caught me.==W== Your reactions are always so entertaining,==W== I can't help it.
But in all seriousness,==W== medical treatment is built entirely on trust.==W== You have to hand over your everything to the other person.==W== That's how it works.
Now you understand why I requested you specifically.==W== If it's you...==W== I wouldn't mind handing over my "everything" at all.==W== That's what I mean.
I... think I get it, mostly...
In that case,==W== let's continue—==W==don't forget, you promised you would "heal" me properly...
I'm looking forward ...==W== to how you'll give me the pleasure~
Ah...==W== That feels wonderful! I did not expect you to be such a talented masseuse.
Phew...==W== I am glad you like it.
Man... Giving a massage is actually quite the workout...
Well?==W== How does it feel to have complete control over my body?
Please stop phrasing it like that!
I-I mean, it allows me to understand you on a deeper level. I can physically feel the fatigue you have accumulated...
Like knowing exactly which muscles are tense.
Besides, I really do want you to properly relax...
If there is a next time, I will always choose you.
After all, getting to touch my body all over like this ...==W== is a privilege reserved only for my most excellent assistants.
